plain: Roswell, New Mexico, the town tied to a famous 1947 crash story, was also home to the 509th, the US bomber unit that carried atomic bombs. Several people tell it that way to suggest that whatever came down there may have been drawn to the nuclear weapons. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff calls it "the first bomber squadron" of its kind in the US. The researcher RedPandaKoala adds that this was the unit that dropped the bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and the scientist John Brandenburg goes further, saying all the nuclear weapons on Earth were stored at Roswell. Jesse Michels says in his own words that Roswell held "the only American nuclear stockpile at the time" and names the officers involved: Jesse Marcel Sr., Walter Haut, William Blanchard and Roger Ramey. Another time he names Curtis LeMay as the unit's leader and asks a guest whether something happened at Roswell.
